frontmatter.title: Fueling the Fermentation: Supporting the Brewing Journey
frontmatter.excerpt: Support my brewing experiments via Ko-fi. Contributions fund quality honey, specialized yeast, and rare fruit additions for detailed mead-making findings.

frontmatter.title: Bottling Day: The Final Stretch
frontmatter.excerpt: Bottling day is the most rewarding and stressful part of homebrewing. Learn my siphon setup, stabilization, pasteurization, and how to avoid bottle bombs.
A Tilt Hydrometer review for homebrewers — real-time Bluetooth gravity and temperature monitoring without drawing samples, plus the flaws that hold it back.

frontmatter.title: My Home Brewing Journey: From Mead to Beer on Tap
frontmatter.excerpt: How I went from a 1-gallon Northern Brewer mead kit to a keezer with beer on tap. My homebrew journey covers YouTube research and gear upgrades over time.

frontmatter.title: Cherry Mead
frontmatter.excerpt: A sweet cherry melomel recipe using wildflower honey, frozen cherries in a mesh bag, and Red Star Premier Blanc yeast with double fruit addition for flavor.

frontmatter.title: Blackberry Mead
frontmatter.excerpt: A deep purple blackberry melomel fermented dry then back-sweetened and bottle-pasteurized. Lessons from a first attempt: take gravity readings and weigh honey.

frontmatter.title: Dandelion Mead
frontmatter.excerpt: A bright floral mead brewed with foraged dandelion petals and Ambrosia honey. Red Star Premier Cote ferments clean, leaving herbal tea notes in a golden pour.

frontmatter.title: Strawberry Wine
frontmatter.excerpt: A fresh strawberry wine recipe using pureed fruit, a Camden tablet to kill wild yeast, and Red Star Cote Des Blancs. One-gallon batch ages a year at 11.3% ABV.

frontmatter.title: PLAATO Airlock Review
frontmatter.excerpt: A PLAATO Airlock review — the smart fermentation tracker that promised bubble-counting gravity, then became a $100 paperweight when the company bailed.

seriesCards.description: A comprehensive guide to water chemistry for mead makers — from ion fundamentals to building custom water profiles for different mead styles.

seriesCards.description: A complete beginner's guide to making mead at home, from equipment and ingredients through fermentation, back-sweetening, pasteurization, and bottling.
